book.name: 2 MAKOLINTE
book.title: Elin̄olo lya Paulusi no wiili ku MAKOLINTE

content: Okusebeza bamweya ni Nyambe, kame tu mi kumbela nji mu lese oku tambula esishemo sa Nyambe mukwa tusa esinjili.
Komumone, cwale enako naikwana, mumone cwale sebeli eliywaa no kuyoyisiwa.
Ka tubekela omunu esi sitataliso mu mundila yaye nji cwale tulese okuwaniwa ni mubonda mu musebezi wetu.
Kono kame tuli abika a Nyambe tukubeeke twenyene mundila yonje mu koongola onene, mu mayando, mu kuulwa mane ni mu tinako no kubambaba,
mu kufuliwa, mu titolongo, mu mifilifili, mu misebezi, mu kutona, nimu lishebo,
mu kukena, mu zibo, ni kutatelela, ni musa ni Mebo No Kukena, mu lilato no niti.
mu kwamba eniti, ni maata a Nyambe ni ilwiso no kuluka mu lyoko no silyo neli no simoo.
Mu kukutekiwa ni mukwakutekiwa, mu kwambiwa ouyi ni uwa. Kame tutendiwa kanyi aongi mi cwale kame twamba eyi no niti,
kanyi katu limukiwa mi cwale kame tulimukiwa wino, kanyi kame tufile mi komumone kame tuyoya, kanyi kame tuna kubiwa ekoto kono katu sikwibaiwa,
kanyi kame twenine kono enako yonje kame tuwabelelwa, kanyi kame tushebile kono kame tufumisa ano kupula, kanyi katukwite einu kandi kame tuluwile einu yonje.
Akanwa ketu kame tu myambela patalaza, Amakolinte, omucima wetu nau yatuluka.
Ka muukele munyima mulibaka lyetu, kono kame muukela munyima mulibaka no mayando enu.
Mu kuusa kame naamba kanyi kame nambela anukana, muyatulule emicima yenu ngeso.
Mu lese okusebeleza bamweya nawo no kwapumena, kakuli oukuwana kubine kuli kwano kuluka na sikutenda ouyi? Simba oulikani no liseli ni uwi?
Kilesite kaumweya ali nawo ni Satani? Simba ngasibine osiku pumena nji akuyupe nawo no kwapumena?
Ibine etumelelano ili ku ndoo ya Nyambe ni ifekiso no kulapela? Kakuli kame tuli Endoo ya Nyambe no kuyoya! Kanyi Nyambe aba anamba nji,

content.text: mi kame sa nitende Nyambe woo,
Mu lese okulema esi no kwakena,
mi anyi mu tende anange no andumbana naa no akatana,
kame kwamba Ombumu no maata onje.”
